note: Every list here is real output recorded in pilot/observations.jsonl: lens_top10 is the J-lens readout at the probe position and self_report is what Qwen3.5-4B answered when asked directly. Only expected_agree is supplied by hand, as the ground truth the judge is scored against. Nothing is invented. Labels are revised when shown to be wrong: the second wedding fixture was relabelled from reject to agree after checking that ' matrim' has no completion outside the matrimony family.

fixtures.prefix: After landing in Tokyo she craved authentic sushi
fixtures.exercises: lens names Japan only as 'Japanese'/'japon' while the self-report says 'japan': the surface-form case the judge exists for

fixtures.prefix: Molten rock flowed down the mountain as glowing lava
fixtures.exercises: lens carries both ' volcano' and the CJK form 火山

fixtures.prefix: The organist began playing as the bride
fixtures.exercises: both lists name the concept outright

fixtures.prefix: After bowing politely, the tourists in kimonos walked toward the temple
fixtures.exercises: neither list names Japan; the lens has temple/Buddha/shrine and the self-report has ritual/shrine, all association

fixtures.prefix: The bride in white walked down the aisle to exchange her vows
fixtures.exercises: relabelled: the lens fragment ' matrim' has no completion in the vocabulary outside the matrimony family (matrimon, matrimoni, matrimoniale, matrimonio), so it unambiguously names matrimony, which denotes a wedding. The original label treated every fragment as naming nothing, which was wrong and was also inconsistent with accepting 'nuptials'. The superordinate 'ceremony' in the same list still does not count.

fixtures.prefix: After lying awake in bed until four in the morning, she felt tired
fixtures.exercises: self-report names 'insomnia' but the lens has only tired/fatigue/exhaustion, which are consequences
the reverse asymmetry: the lens does name ' chess' but the self-report drifted to battle/war/castle and never names it
